purpose: Decide from public image geometry alone whether the figure-only Loubser BCG dynamics host is worth a frozen raw-Gemini reconstruction. This is an acquisition prescreen, not a lens or gravity fit.
selection_blinding: A1689 was selected because it independently appears in the completed Loubser dynamics inventory and has a primary machine-readable multiple-image catalog. No gravity residual or model preference was inspected.

distance_conversion.origin: Coe et al. 2010 reports 47.0 arcsec as 143 kpc for A1689; the ratio is used only for frozen radial-support bookkeeping
distance_conversion.role: geometry only; not a gravity or cosmology target

dynamics_support.origin: typical one-sided support stated for the Loubser et al. radial profiles

lens_source.primary_catalog: Coe et al. 2010, ApJ 723, 1678, CDS J/ApJ/723/1678 tables 5 and 7
lens_source.independent_redshift_policy: Use a table-5 spectroscopic redshift when present. Otherwise retain the table-5 Bayesian photometric redshift and its published 95-percent interval. Table-7 input/output lens redshifts remain audit-only.
forbidden_as_input: table-7 input redshifts lacking independent table-5 spectroscopy or photometry
published convergence or NFW mass maps

failure_policy: If the same-radius gate fails, retain A1689 as a valid lens catalog and documented geometry shortfall, but do not spend a raw-spectra reduction cycle or extend the 15-kpc support after inspecting a model.
